purpose: Same-notation control (M2) and prompt-prohibition contrast, supporting Section V factors analysis. M2 is an additional control introduced by this study, not part of the assignment requirement.

null_guard_counts_contract_fields.measurement: occurrences of the string x <> null inside preconditions/postconditions/invariants/guard/effect fields of MES files; historical notes cited 37 for M4 (earlier counting method), current reproducible count is 31

coverage_manual.note: manual semantic labeling, 31 atoms at L0 and 13 at L1, evidence per atom in coverage_manual.json

comparison_M1_vs_M2_same_notation.coverage_L1: M1 0.615 (misses TH-1/3/4/5/6) vs M2 0.808 (misses TH-3, partial TH-4/5/6)
comparison_M1_vs_M2_same_notation.formal_precision: M1 0.914/0.800 vs M2 0.957/1.000 — M2 inflated by 57 vacuous x <> null guards that the ambiguity metric does not count
comparison_M1_vs_M2_same_notation.consistency: M1 0.749/0.737 vs M2 0.601/0.458 — M2 depressed by ID-based external references and child-module parent-level references (scoring-convention artifact, same class as M3)

comparison_M2_vs_M4_same_generator.formal_precision_L1: SOFL M2 1.000 vs UML M4 0.600 — notation ceiling confirmed with generator held constant
comparison_M2_vs_M4_same_generator.coverage_L1: M2 0.808 vs M4 1.000 — UML class model enumerates threshold clauses better; SOFL replica holds them in contracts

artifact_notes: M2 and M3 register externals with ids (E1..E9) while flows reference those ids; the scorer canonicalises external names only, so such flows count as unresolved in both — depresses D2 equally for both, not a modelling defect
M2 L1 flows referencing parent-level elements (F1/F2/F4/E3/E7) are cross-level references, unresolvable within the child document by construction
